python3 -c "
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

# Plant 1 (left plant):
# Visible in obs 1, 7, 13, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20 (partially)
# In obs 1: camera at (0,0), heading +y
# Plant pot: x=[129, 152], y=[300, 323], bottom y=323.
# Let's check plant 1 pot across frames 1, 7, 13, 16, 17:
for f, pose in [(1, (0,0)), (7, (0,0.5)), (13, (0,1.0)), (16, (0.5,1.0)), (17, (0.5,1.5))]:
    arr = np.array(Image.open(f'/work/observations/obs_{f:04d}.png').convert('RGB'))
    # pot color: reddish brown
    pot_m = (arr[:, :, 0] > 140) & (arr[:, :, 0] < 220) & (arr[:, :, 1] > 60) & (arr[:, :, 1] < 120) & (arr[:, :, 2] < 70) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] < 200)
    yp, xp = np.where(pot_m)
    if len(yp) > 10:
        d = 1.55 * 256 / (yp.max() - 255.5)
        center_x = (xp.min() + xp.max()) / 2.0
        x_w = pose[0] + (center_x - 255.5) / 256.0 * d
        y_w = pose[1] + d
        print(f'Frame {f}: bottom_y={yp.max()}, x=[{xp.min()},{xp.max()}], d={d:.3f}, x_world={x_w:.3f}, y_world={y_w:.3f}')
"
